description: The source compares greenhouse area in square feet and total sales in dollars for Alberta and Canada, including Alberta shares. Two spreadsheet releases cover 2006–2014 and 2007–2015 and are grouped with their overlapping periods retained. The engineered asset measure is greenhouse area; sales are contextual economic observations. It does not establish greenhouse construction, heating technology, energy demand, crop yields or individual facility capacities. The two releases were not numerically compared. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
